description: "Disable encodings/transformations of device output (platformio.ini option monitor_raw)."
---

# `monitor_raw`

- **Type:** Boolean: `yes` or `no`
- **Multiple values:** No
- **Default:** `no`

Disable encodings/transformations/filters of device output. See [`pio device monitor --raw`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-raw).
